title: Drum Mode (Digitone MIDI track drum sequencer)
author: morriess
description: Drum Mode turns a Digitone mk1 MIDI track into an 8-lane drum sequencer on the track's own MIDI channel. Milestone 2, live lanes: DRUM MODE in the Mod Menu (hold a track key) toggles it for the active MIDI track; then trig keys 1-8 play the 8 lane notes (GM drum map) on the track's channel, several at once, and the screen's corner shows which lanes play. It names no firmware address, so its OS 1.44 port is empty. Needs core-dn1 5.3.
